comment: Differences between Chromium 156 and the native engine that tests/abi/blob_urls.py records instead of failing. Approved by root for #144.

differences.reader.text.final.result.value: readAsText without an encoding: WebKit decodes with the blob type's charset parameter (latin1 here), as the File API's 'get an encoding' step specifies; Chromium decodes UTF-8. With an explicit encoding both agree (textLatin1, textUtf16, textBogusLabel, textBomWins).
differences.teardown.promise: A blob read in flight when its document goes away: the native read delivers RV_RESOURCE_INVALIDATED, the H05 operation contract; Chromium leaves the removed document's Blob.text() promise pending.
